title: Fixed Twin-pendulum Park Air Walker
description: One complete newly authored static park air-walker exercise apparatus. A continuous inverted-U upper handrail and two full grounded runner shoes support two independent transverse axle journals. Each journal carries its own long rigid pendulum arm descending to a complete thick open foot tray with real raised side rims; the two pedals are fixed in opposite fore-and-aft positions. The open central standing region and separated suspended pedal platforms differ from a seated cycling crank, sliding rowing carriage or a rope-suspended swing seat. Nine closed editable meshes and four opaque PBR materials, one prop and zero scenes. Static game-art appearance only: no real motion, bearing clearance, exercise guidance, user fit, load, stability, anchoring or public-fitness safety certification.
